*Must  have the following*
- [ ] Determine the issue has all information/screenshots.
- [ ] Determine if the issue can be reproduced
- [ ] Assign the target component that needs a fix?
- [ ] Assign the team member who will do the work.
- [ ] Put the task in milestone or backlog.
- [ ] Updated the issue to done status after responding to the owner.
